name: northwind-support-desk
description: Support ticket management system — .NET API and React web client in one repository

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d sqlserver
scripts.build: dotnet build && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: dotnet test && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.ef: dotnet tool restore && dotnet ef --project apps/api/src/SupportDesk.Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/SupportDesk.Presentation
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet tool restore && dotnet ef database update --project apps/api/src/SupportDesk.Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/SupportDesk.Presentation
